text.zh-TW: 確認每個人的護照效期符合目的地的入境要求
text.en: Confirm everyone's passport is valid long enough for the destination's entry rules

text.zh-TW: 確認需不需要簽證或電子旅行授權（ETA），需要的話何時申請、要多久
text.en: Confirm whether a visa or electronic travel authority (ETA) is needed, and how long it takes

text.zh-TW: 確認旅遊保險：醫療額度、班機延誤、自駕或活動是否除外
text.en: Confirm travel insurance: medical cover, delays, and whether driving or activities are excluded

text.zh-TW: 確認上網方式（eSIM、當地 SIM 或漫遊）與手機是否支援
text.en: Confirm how you will get online (eSIM, local SIM or roaming) and that your phone supports it

text.zh-TW: 確認現金需求：哪些地方只收現金、要換多少、提款手續費
text.en: Confirm cash needs: where only cash works, how much to change, ATM fees

text.zh-TW: 確認信用卡已開海外交易、知道海外手續費；刷卡時選當地幣
text.en: Confirm your cards work abroad and what the foreign transaction fee is; pay in the local currency

text.zh-TW: 確認是否需要疫苗，以及常備藥要不要帶處方或英文證明
text.en: Confirm whether vaccines are needed and whether medicines need a prescription or letter

label.zh-TW: 衛生福利部疾病管制署

text.zh-TW: 確認目的地海關對食物、藥品、現金的申報規定
text.en: Confirm what the destination's customs ask you to declare (food, medicines, cash)

text.zh-TW: 確認每一段航班的行李限額（國內線常比國際線少）
text.en: Confirm the baggage allowance of every flight (domestic legs are often smaller)

text.zh-TW: 確認航班時間、航站與是否跨日抵達
text.en: Confirm flight times, terminals and any arrival on the next day

text.zh-TW: 確認駐外館處的緊急聯絡方式並存進手機
text.en: Confirm the embassy or representative office's emergency contact and save it

text.zh-TW: 確認護照影本、保單、訂位紀錄已放進文件夾
text.en: Confirm passport copies, insurance and bookings are in Documents

text.zh-TW: 確認已把 app 加到主畫面、下載離線地圖
text.en: Confirm the app is on your home screen and offline maps are downloaded

text.zh-TW: 確認當地季節與天氣（看當地氣象局）
text.en: Confirm the season and weather (the local weather service)

text.zh-TW: 護照
text.en: Passport

text.zh-TW: 信用卡與少量現金
text.en: Cards and some cash

text.zh-TW: 手機與充電線
text.en: Phone and charging cable

text.zh-TW: 個人藥品
text.en: Personal medicines

text.zh-TW: 換洗衣物
text.en: Clothes

text.zh-TW: 外套與雨具
text.en: Jacket and rain gear

text.zh-TW: 盥洗用品
text.en: Toiletries

text.zh-TW: 眼鏡或隱形眼鏡
text.en: Glasses or contact lenses

text.zh-TW: 行動電源（放隨身行李）
text.en: Power bank (in carry-on)

text.zh-TW: 轉接頭（確認當地插座規格）
text.en: Plug adapters (check the local socket type)

text.zh-TW: 常備藥品（感冒、腸胃、OK 繃）
text.en: First-aid kit (cold, stomach, plasters)

text.zh-TW: 延長線
text.en: Power strip

text.zh-TW: 濕紙巾與衛生紙
text.en: Wet wipes and tissues

text.zh-TW: 大塑膠袋或收納袋
text.en: Large bags for laundry and rubbish
